title: Dressing Up
hook: Peppa 和 George 在爸妈卧室里翻出大人的衣服穿在身上，把爸爸妈妈都骗过去了。

cells.q: Where were Peppa and George playing?
cells.a: They were playing in Mummy and Daddy's bedroom.
cells.cn: 他们在爸爸妈妈的卧室里玩。

cells.a: She found Daddy Pig's big coat and put it on.
cells.cn: 她找到爸爸的大外套，穿在身上。

cells.q: What did Peppa want to look like?
cells.a: She said, “I need to look beautiful, just like Mummy.”
cells.cn: 她说要打扮得像妈妈一样漂亮。

cells.a: She was working on her computer.
She said, “Excuse me, I've got a lot of work to do!”
cells.cn: 她说：“抱歉，我还有很多工作要做！”

cells.a: He was digging in the garden.
She hoped Daddy was not digging in his best clothes.
cells.cn: 她希望爸爸别穿着最好的衣服挖土。

cells.a: They wondered, “So, where are Peppa and George?”
cells.cn: 他们纳闷：Peppa 和 George 去哪儿了？

cells.a: They were outside in the big clothes! “There you are!”
cells.cn: 他们穿着大衣服站在外面——“找到你们啦！”

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: coat, beautiful, work, dig, clothes, where
helper.actions: play, put on, look, work, dig, laugh

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Dressing Up”.
ending: In the end, the parents find the children in their big clothes. My favourite part is ______.
